notes: you can add one new bao a day, next to today's things

every floor has its own stairs and a ladder, inside the rooms
the baos never stop building now: a porch, a garden, courts, a bowling alley, even a lake
stairs! no more ladders between floors
the bathroom and one bedroom got a front wall and a big window
press and hold furniture to move it to any room
double-tap a bao to zoom in and follow it
